posts.description: If LLMs solved creating code, why does the whole industry talk about nothing else than how to create code with LLMs?

Quality is inherently slow. It comes from the amount of time it takes to make thousands of thoughtful decisions on how to solve a problem. Mass production didn’t change that. The time-consuming work just shifted to the planning, engineering, and logistics stages. So what about mass-produced or LLM-generated code? In software, quality also comes from taking the time to understand the problem deeply
Overrated: Making predictions by extrapolating a history of data points.
